papers.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
papers.summary: VideoNexus separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning, using perception sub-agents to return compact temporally grounded evidence and achieving higher accuracy at lower cost on long-video benchmarks.
